# Let's parse the note content to extract the songs and artists that have "RELEASED_AT TODO".
import re

note_content = note["content"]
todo_songs = []

# Each song is on its own line, format: "- <title> BY <artist(s)> RELEASED_AT <date or TODO>"
for line in note_content.splitlines():
    match = re.match(r"- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT TODO", line.strip())
    if match:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        artists = match.group(2).strip()
        todo_songs.append({"title": title, "artists": artists})

print(todo_songs)
